summary: The candidate is a verified partial mitigation: automatic TCPStore ports avoid Linux's ephemeral range and its focused tests pass, but the reservation is still released before TCPStore binds and the reported explicit --nccl-port 30101 DP=8 configuration still reuses one port across replicas. It therefore does not establish unique, collision-free ports for the full original contract.

tests.what_was_measured: 64/64 old allocator samples were inside 32768-60999; after the controller-style reservation was released and an unrelated client acquired the port, real torch.distributed.TCPStore failed with DistNetworkError EADDRINUSE.
Candidate regression and focused PortArgs suite: 37 passed. Imports resolved to the exact checkout under /job/repo/python.

Eight automatically chosen ports were outside the ephemeral range and eight real TCPStores bound; independently acquiring a chosen port after reservation release still caused real TCPStore EADDRINUSE.

tests.command: Candidate PortArgs.init_new/bind_port loop with ServerArgs(model_path='dummy', dp_size=8, nccl_port=30101)
tests.what_was_measured: Every allocation returned explicit port 30101; repeated reservations failed with OSError by DP iteration 2 (the third replica), demonstrating the original explicit-port mode is not made unique per replica.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and candidate change are Python socket/TCPStore initialization paths. Tests used real CPU TCPStore networking. No GPU kernel or model server was executed.

remaining_counterexamples: A listener that acquires the selected non-ephemeral port after DataParallelController closes its reservation and before TCPStore binds still produces the reported EADDRINUSE.
With the reported --nccl-port 30101 and --dp 8, candidate PortArgs returns the same explicit port for each independent DP scheduler; repeated reservation cannot provide eight unique ports.
When procfs is unavailable or the non-ephemeral range is exhausted, the candidate intentionally falls back to the old ephemeral allocator and restores the original race exposure.
remaining_limitations: Prepared hardware is one AMD MI355X/gfx950-class GPU with ROCm 7.2, not eight NVIDIA H800 GPUs with CUDA/NCCL.
Qwen3-Embedding weights were unavailable, so full serving startup and intermittent frequency were not measured.
The tiny transport fixture was unnecessary for this TCPStore allocator review and would not qualify the Qwen3-Embedding architecture or eight-GPU distributed workload.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
